services.justification: startup dynamic host wiring between composition root and dynamic runtime
script generation host factory and runtime glue for user commands
worker-side script runtime owned by the child process, not the parent
parent-side dynamic runtime owning staged generation lifecycle
parent-side script host owning command session lifecycle
dynamic host protocol implementation for staged evaluation
settings service owning runtime application of validated settings
command service owning user-script session lifecycle and bridging
profile service owning profile switch and command root resolution
settings runtime glue between pipeline output and live services

note: Scope limits: names only, not versions (versions stay locked via Cargo.lock + workspace-lock-check); trait scan covers rust/pokecon/src/**/*.rs including #[cfg(test)] modules via a `pub trait NAME` line regex, so commented-out lines and macro-generated traits are out of scope; tests/fixtures paths are excluded by construction (outside src/) with explicit exclusion constants in the check; conversion inventory is file-level (files containing impl From/TryFrom), not item-level, per AR-11-39.
